data.title: TPG, Corpay to take BILL private in $6B acquisition
data.description:
Key points:
  • BILL said on Thursday that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by TPG, a leading global alternative asset management firm, in partnership with Corpay for $6B.
  • BILL will receive $63.25 per share in an all-cash transaction, representing a 31% premium to the 60-day volume-weighted average price ending on November 16.
  • TPG will acquire a majority interest in BILL through TPG Capital, the firm’s U.S. and European private equity platform, and Corpay will acquire a minority interest.
  • Upon the close of the transaction, BILL will become a privately held company, and its common stock will no longer be listed on any public stock exchange.
  • BILL -3.25% to $62.00.

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 19, 2026) - Copper-gold explorer and hybrid project generator Kincora Copper Limited (Kincora or the Company) is pleased to announce the results of voting at its Annual General and Special Meeting ("AGM" or the "Meeting") on November 19th, 2026 at 4pm PST held by hybrid meeting with webcast from Vancouver, Canada.

All matters submitted to shareholders for approval as set out in the Company's Notice of Meeting and Information Circular, dated October 9th, 2026, were approved by the requisite majority of votes cast at the Meeting with 21.25% of shareholder proxies returned and very strong support for all matters of business.

Details of the resolutions are provided below. A copy of the presentation discussed at the Meeting will be made available on the Kincora website: https://www.kincoracopper.com/investors#services

Chairman Cameron McRae commented:

"At last year's AGM, we highlighted the importance of laying the foundations for Kincora's next phase of growth, with a share consolidation and strategic placement aligning key shareholders.

It is pleasing to reflect on how we have started to build on these and form a significant hybrid prospect generator providing unique portfolio exposure to large scale copper-gold discovery.

We are achieving a step change in scale with the drill bit, size of the project portfolio, management fee income and cash position. Today, Kincora is a more focused and better-capitalized company, with more metres going into the ground at more targets.

We are still in the early stage of execution with a very exciting 2027 ahead of us.

We thank our shareholders for their continued support and look forward to building on the progress achieved as we enter the next phase of Kincora's growth."

ABOUT KINCORA

Kincora Copper Limited is an emerging Australia-focused gold-copper explorer with a hybrid project generator strategy.

The Company is successfully proving up the prospectivity of its extensive project portfolio, which includes multiple district-scale landholdings and scalable drill ready targets. These assets are in Australia's Lachlan Fold Belt, one of the globe's leading porphyry belts, and the historical Condobolin mining field within the Cobar basin in NSW.

The Company has already unlocked over A$100 million of potential partner funding for multiple earlier stage and/or non-core porphyry projects. These initial deals have supported approximately 25,000 metres of drilling and over A$12m of partner funded exploration since late 2024, with management fees and exploration ramping up.

With a strong cash position of approximately A$13 million, and a further US$3.5-million due before year end (~A$5-million), the Company is now increasing sole funded exploration activities and increasing the scale of its project portfolio.

Various independent reviews have recently taken place supporting a formal process for the next leg of asset level partnerships for the remaining large scale porphyry projects.

During the Australian summer, Kincora plans to invest up to A$3 million in sole-funded, shallow air-core drilling advancing geological concepts and adding scale across four projects and 17 targets. Further to this, preparations are in place to undertake the first drilling in over twenty years at the outcropping mineralised Boree Creek project, which Kincora has a low-cost option over.

The programs are also expected to complement and enhance the value equation of asset-level partner discussions that are ongoing for the remaining 100% owned flagship and advanced exploration stage porphyry projects that are hosted in brownfield environments to existing world-class mines.

By having a significant portfolio of partner funded large porphyry projects and focused capital efficient programs at sole funded projects, the Company is seeking to position Kincora as a leading institutional grade explorer in the public Australian and Canadian markets, and the leading project generator on the ASX.

Only 38 stocks among the S&P 500 rose on Thursday amid a broad decline across the major U.S. indexes, as the successful completion of Anthropic's record initial public offering sucked the wind out of the market.

The stock market opened broadly higher, as strong demand for Anthropic's (ANT) IPO gave investors reason to be optimistic. data.title: Revolution Medicines Presents Updated Phase 1/2 Data for RASONQUE® (daraxonrasib) Plus Chemotherapy in First-Line Metastatic Pancreatic Cancer at ENA 2026
data.description:
Key points:
  • With additional patients and longer follow-up, the combination of RASONQUE plus gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel demonstrated deep and durable responses in the first-line treatment setting
  • Results support the ongoing Phase 3 RASolute 303 trial in patients with treatment-naïve metastatic pancreatic cancer

REDWOOD CITY, Calif., Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Revolution Medicines, Inc. , a global, commercial-stage oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers, today announced encouraging updated results from the Phase 1/2 RMC-GI-102 open-label study evaluating RASONQUE (daraxonrasib) in combination with gemcitabine and nab-paclitaxel (GnP) as a potential first-line treatment for patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC). The data will be presented today during a late-breaking oral session at the EORTC-NCI-AACR (ENA) Symposium on Molecular Targets and Cancer Therapeutics in Barcelona, Spain.

As of September 28, 2026, 61 patients in the first-line metastatic PDAC cohort of the Phase 1/2 RMC-GI-102 open-label study had received RASONQUE (200 mg) plus GnP, with median follow-up of 18.3 months. In the updated analysis, the confirmed objective response rate was 60.7% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 47.3–72.9), including complete responses in 8.2% of patients. The disease control rate was 90.2% (95% CI: 79.8–96.3) and median duration of response was 11.1 months (95% CI: 7.6- 18.4). Median progression free survival (PFS) was 12.8 months (95% CI: 10.8–18.4) and the twelve-month overall survival was 76.6% (95% CI: 63.7-85.4). The safety profile was consistent with the known safety profiles previously observed for both RASONQUE and GnP. This update builds on findings previously presented at the American Association for Cancer Research (AACR) Annual Meeting in April 2026.

“With longer follow-up and a larger patient population, we are seeing a notable combination of high response rates, including deep complete responses, and durable disease control, with median progression-free survival exceeding one year,” said Wungki Park, M.D., M.S., medical oncologist at the David M. Rubenstein Center for Pancreatic Cancer Research at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, RMC-GI-102 and RASolute 303 investigator, and presenter of the data at ENA. “The emerging survival signal is meaningful and is estimated at 76.6% for patients to be alive at one year. Taken together, these findings provide a compelling rationale to further evaluate daraxonrasib as a potential first-line treatment option.”

“People with treatment-naïve metastatic pancreatic cancer urgently need more effective treatment options, given the limited clinical benefit of current chemotherapy regimens,” said Alan Sandler, M.D., chief development officer of Revolution Medicines. “The FDA’s recent Breakthrough Therapy Designation for RASONQUE plus GnP in this setting underscores the urgency of this work. The durability of treatment shown with these updated Phase 1/2 results is particularly encouraging and supports the ongoing Phase 3 RASolute 303 trial, which is evaluating RASONQUE both as a monotherapy and in combination with GnP versus GnP alone in patients with treatment-naïve metastatic PDAC, independent of tumor RAS genotype.”

The presentation (8LBA), titled “Daraxonrasib plus Gemcitabine/Nab-Paclitaxel (GnP) as First-Line (1L) Treatment for Patients (Pts) with Metastatic Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (mPDAC),” will be delivered by Dr. Park during a late-breaking oral session on November 20, 2026, at the ENA Symposium in Barcelona, Spain.

About Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma (PDAC)

Pancreatic adenocarcinoma, or PDAC, is the most common form of pancreatic cancer and among the most challenging malignancies. RAS, a key growth control switch in human cells, is the main driver of pancreatic cancer, which is characterized by excessive RAS signaling. Each year, approximately 500,000 people globally are diagnosed with PDAC and it is the seventh leading cause of cancer-related deaths worldwide.1,2

Because early-stage pancreatic cancer often causes few or no symptoms, approximately 80% of patients are diagnosed after the disease has spread, when treatment options are more limited.3 For patients with metastatic PDAC, the five-year relative survival rate is approximately 3% worldwide.4

About RASONQUE® (daraxonrasib)

RASONQUE (daraxonrasib) is an oral, RAS(ON) multi-selective, noncovalent, tri-complex inhibitor (TCI), approved by the U.S. FDA for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PDAC) who have received at least one prior systemic therapy or who are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy.5 In the European Union, RASONQUE is approved by the European Commission for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy. RASONQUE is being investigated through a global Phase 3 registrational program in patients with PDAC and metastatic RAS mutant non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Outside the U.S. and the European Union, RASONQUE is an investigational agent that has not been approved by any regulatory authority.

U.S. FDA APPROVED INDICATION

RASONQUE is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy or who are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy.

IMPORTANT SAFETY INFORMATION FOR U.S. APPROVED INDICATION

RASONQUE is associated with the following Warnings and Precautions: Dermatologic and Soft Tissue Toxicity, Stomatitis and Oral Disorders, Diarrhea, Gastrointestinal Perforation, Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD)/Pneumonitis, and Embryo-Fetal Toxicity.

WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS

Dermatologic and Soft Tissue Toxicity

RASONQUE can cause dermatologic toxicity, which may be severe. Clinical manifestations included, but were not limited to, rash, pruritus, paronychia, dry skin, and skin fissures. In clinical trials of patients with pancreatic adenocarcinoma, dermatologic toxicity occurred in 86% of patients treated with RASONQUE, of which 10% were Grade 3.

Monitor patients who develop dermatologic or soft tissue toxicities while receiving RASONQUE. Initiate prophylactic measures (e.g., topical corticosteroids, emollient creams, sunscreen, oral antibiotics) prior to the first dose of RASONQUE to reduce the risk of moderate to severe dermatologic reactions. Advise patients to limit sun exposure while taking RASONQUE. Initiate supportive measures (e.g., oral corticosteroids) as clinically indicated, and consider dermatologic consultation. Withhold, reduce the dose, or permanently discontinue RASONQUE based on severity.

Stomatitis and Oral Disorders

RASONQUE can cause stomatitis, including mouth ulcers and oral mucositis. In clinical trials of patients with pancreatic adenocarcinoma, stomatitis occurred in 57% of patients, of which 9% were Grade 3.

Monitor patients for signs and symptoms of stomatitis while receiving RASONQUE. Initiate a steroid-containing mouthwash for treatment of stomatitis and administer other topical treatments (e.g., chlorhexidine mouthwash, 2% lidocaine viscous) as clinically indicated. Withhold, reduce the dose, or permanently discontinue RASONQUE based on severity.

Diarrhea

RASONQUE can cause diarrhea. In clinical trials of patients with pancreatic adenocarcinoma, diarrhea occurred in 63% of patients, of which 6% were Grade 3.

If diarrhea occurs, administer antidiarrheal treatment as clinically indicated. Withhold, reduce the dose, or permanently discontinue RASONQUE based on severity.

Gastrointestinal Perforation

RASONQUE can cause gastrointestinal perforation. In clinical trials of patients with pancreatic adenocarcinoma, gastrointestinal perforation occurred in 0.9% of patients treated with RASONQUE, of which 0.5% were Grade 3, one event was Grade 4, and one event was fatal.

Monitor patients for gastrointestinal perforation. Withhold RASONQUE if gastrointestinal perforation is suspected. Reduce the dose or permanently discontinue RASONQUE if no other potential causes of gastrointestinal perforation are identified.

Interstitial Lung Disease (ILD)/Pneumonitis

RASONQUE can cause interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis. In clinical trials of patients with pancreatic adenocarcinoma, ILD/pneumonitis occurred in 2.4% of patients treated with RASONQUE, of which 0.9% were Grade 3, and one event was fatal.

Monitor patients for new or worsening pulmonary symptoms. Withhold RASONQUE if ILD/pneumonitis is suspected. Reduce the dose or permanently discontinue RASONQUE if no other potential causes of ILD/pneumonitis are identified.

Embryo-Fetal Toxicity

Based on findings in animals, RASONQUE can cause fetal harm when administered to a pregnant woman. Advise females of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment with RASONQUE and for 1 week after the last dose. Advise males with female partners of reproductive potential to use effective contraception during treatment with RASONQUE and for 1 week after the last dose.

ADVERSE REACTIONS

Serious adverse reactions occurred in 30% of patients treated with RASONQUE. Serious adverse reactions occurring in ≥ 2% of patients treated with RASONQUE were diarrhea (3.7%), pyrexia (3.3%), sepsis (2.9%), fatigue (2.1%), and hemorrhage (2.1%).

Adverse reactions leading to permanent discontinuation of RASONQUE occurred in 2.9% of patients, including two patients who discontinued due to rash (0.8%).

The most common (≥ 20%) adverse reactions in patients treated with RASONQUE were rash, diarrhea, stomatitis, nausea, fatigue, vomiting, abdominal pain, edema, decreased appetite, and hemorrhage.

DRUG INTERACTIONS

  • Strong CYP3A Inhibitors with P-gp Inhibition: Avoid concomitant use.
  • Strong CYP3A Inhibitors without P-gp Inhibition: Reduce RASONQUE dosage.
  • Moderate CYP3A Inhibitors with or without P-gp Inhibition: Reduce RASONQUE dosage.
  • P-gp Inhibitors: Reduce RASONQUE dosage.
  • Cyclosporine A: Avoid concomitant use.
  • Strong CYP3A Inducers: Avoid concomitant use. Increase RASONQUE dosage if concomitant use cannot be avoided.
  • Moderate CYP3A Inducers: Increase RASONQUE dosage.
  • P-gp Substrates: Take at least 4 hours apart from RASONQUE.

PROPHYLACTIC MEASURES

When initiating RASONQUE and throughout treatment, prophylactic and concomitant medications are recommended to reduce the risk of dermatologic reactions:

  • administer a topical corticosteroid (applied to the face and chest) and emollient creams;
  • advise patients to limit sun exposure and use broad-spectrum sunscreen (SPF 30 or higher); and
  • consider prophylactic oral antibiotics (e.g., doxycycline or minocycline).

Please see U.S. Full Prescribing Information for RASONQUE.

About Revolution Medicines, Inc.

Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-stage oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide. data.title: Intuit Selling Mailchimp for $3.68B to Berkshire Hathaway-Backed Bending Spoons — Update
data.description:
By Katherine Hamilton

Intuit has agreed to sell its email automation platform Mailchimp for $3.68 billion to Bending Spoons, the owner of several wayward tech brands that recently attracted a major investment from Berkshire Hathaway.

The purchase price includes $3.31 billion in cash and $368 million in Bending Spoons stock.

The deal comes about a month after Bending Spoons revealed that Berkshire Hathaway had invested about $930 million in the company, accumulating a 4% stake. The Milan-based company said at the time the investment would provide fresh funds to pursue additional acquisitions.

Mailchimp joins an eclectic stable of digital brands Bending Spoons owns including AOL, Everbrite, Evernote, Vimeo and others. Bending Spoons Chief Executive Luca Ferrari said his company, which went public in July, plans to invest substantially in Mailchimp once the deal closes.

Intuit said selling Mailchimp would allow it to focus on its core products, including Quickbooks, Credit Karma and TurboTax, where it is implementing more AI features. The company plans to use cash proceeds to buy back shares during fiscal 2027.

"It's better for our focus, better for our capital allocation," Chief Executive Sasan Goodarzi said on a call with investors.

The deal, which is expected to close early in 2027, came as both companies released their quarterly earnings.

Intuit reported a higher profit as revenue rose 12% to $4.35 billion in its fiscal first quarter, with results topping analyst estimates. Sales in Intuit's business-facing segment increased 15%, while its consumer-facing sales rose 7%.

Mailchimp's revenue declined 1% to $313 million in the quarter.

For the full year, Intuit said it now expected revenue between $23.08 billion to $23.37 billion, down from its prior view for $23.28 billion to $23.51 billion. It expects earnings per share of $20.12 to $20.36.

For the current second quarter, Intuit projected revenue of $4.93 billion to $4.95 billion, with earnings per share between $2.55 and $2.60. Both projections were below analysts' estimates of $5.11 billion in sales and $3.73 a share in earnings.

Bending Spoons, meanwhile, raised its outlook for the year, after reporting higher profit and revenue in the third quarter.

Shares of Intuit fell almost 10% in late trading to $297.25, while shares of Bending Spoons rose 4.3% to $43.50.

data.title: Anthropic To Join MSCI Large Cap And FTSE Global Indexes After Record IPO
data.description:
Key points:
  • Anthropic has been added via fast entry to key FTSE Global Equity Index Series benchmarks, effective December 21, FTSE Russell said on Thursday.
  • The Claude parent will also be added to the Large Cap Segment of the MSCI Global Standard Indexes as of the close of November 30, MSCI said.
  • Anthropic opened on Nasdaq on Thursday at a 34% premium to the offer price of $83 and closed at $97.17.

Anthropic (ANT) is set for entry into major global benchmarks after its record IPO, with FTSE Russell confirming a fast-entry addition to its Global Equity Index Series effective December 21 and MSCI confirming early inclusion in its Global Standard Indexes as of the close of November 30.

Inclusion into a stock index triggers automatic buying by passive index funds and ETFs that must hold the index’s constituents, hiking demand and pushing up share prices. Anthropic closed its first day of trading on the Nasdaq 17% above its IPO price on Thursday before slipping 2.5% after-hours.

Anthropic has been added via fast entry to key FTSE Global Equity Index Series benchmarks, effective December 21, FTSE Russell said on Thursday. The additions cover the FTSE All-World Index, FTSE MPF All-World Index, FTSE Developed Index, FTSE Global Large Cap Index, and FTSE Developed ex Multinational Index.

Anthropic will also be added to the Large Cap Segment of the MSCI Global Standard Indexes as of the close of November 30, coinciding with the November Index Review, MSCI said. The decision follows confirmation that the company’s full and free-float-adjusted market capitalizations, based on its Thursday’s closing price, meet MSCI’s early-inclusion criteria.

Anthropic's Record-Breaking IPO 

Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, above the initial $70–$78 range, and began trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker ANT on Thursday.

The company sold approximately 980 million Class A shares, raising about $81.3 billion—the largest IPO on record and the first public listing of a major frontier AI developer. Combined with a concurrent $26 billion private placement, total proceeds reached roughly $107 billion. The deal valued the Claude AI maker at approximately $1.5 trillion at the IPO price; shares opened higher, briefly pushing the fully diluted valuation near $2 trillion.

New Ships, Expanded Destinations and Enhanced Guest Experiences Shape Carnival's Next Chapter

NEW YORK, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire-HISPANIC PR WIRE/ -- Carnival Cruise Line President Christine Duffy today announced plans for two new ships that will introduce a new class to the Carnival fleet. To be built by long-time partner Fincantieri and delivered in 2033 and 2035, the approximately 130,000-gross-ton LNG-powered ships are intentionally designed on a smaller scale, enabling access to more ports and expanding destination and itinerary choices.

"With a 29-ship fleet, we know our guests appreciate choices," said Duffy. "They love the incredible experiences and amenities on our Excel Class ships, the largest in our fleet, but they also love the intimacy our smaller ships offer. This new class gives us the best of both worlds, helping future-proof our fleet with the flexibility to take America's Cruise Line to even more places in the years ahead."

Duffy also shared a first look at Carnival Destiny, major expansions at Celebration Key, Grand Bahama, enhancements at RelaxAway, Half Moon Cay and plans to extend popular onboard benefits ashore. With more than 6.5 million guests sailing each year, Carnival has a unique perspective on what guests want from their vacations and is putting that feedback at the center of what comes next.

"Guests are seeking more choice, more flexibility and more ways to make the most of their time together," said Duffy. "What we are announcing today reflects how we're making Carnival cruise vacations even more personal, connected and fun."

Carnival Destiny Delivers More Choice with More Sea to See

Carnival Destiny, debuting in 2029 and the first of three Ace Class ships, is designed to give guests more ways to shape their cruise vacation around what they enjoy most. Built around its promise of More Sea to See, the ship will bring guests closer to the ocean with more outdoor space, expansive views and venues that make the sea part of the experience. Highlights include:

  • More outdoor pools than any other Carnival ship, including the first outward-facing main pool zone. Throughout the ship there will be eight pools, including six infinity pools, totaling more than 11,200 square feet of water surface,
  • An expansive ocean-front lanai that features several pools and brings dining and bar venues closer to the sea,
  • New premium venues with sweeping multideck ocean views, including a new exclusive pool on Deck 18 Aft, a total of 25 new dining and bar experiences, as well as a reimagined Limelight Lounge.

Carnival Destiny will dedicate nearly twice the space to family venues and attractions compared with Carnival's newest ships, bringing a family zone with mini golf, arcades, dining and other family favorites together in one area. It will also introduce Dr. Seuss Splash Station, a new splash pad inspired by The Cat in the Hat and Thing One and Thing Two, featuring water cannons and a dedicated area for children in swim diapers. The new attraction builds on Carnival's 13-year partnership with Dr. Seuss Enterprises and expands its popular Seuss at Sea programming.

Adults will have more choices of their own, with Carnival Destiny introducing Carnival's first adult-only zone spanning four decks. The zone will feature Carnival's first adult-only staterooms, an expanded Serenity adult-only retreat and an exclusive rooftop pool deck.

More Choice Ashore: The Next Evolution of Paradise Collection

Duffy also shared that Carnival is expanding the choices available ashore with the next evolution of Paradise Collection by Carnival, the largest portfolio of exclusive destinations across The Bahamas, Caribbean and Mexico.

The collection includes six distinct destinations: Celebration Key in Grand Bahama; RelaxAway, Half Moon Cay; Isla Tropicale in Roatan; Amber Cove in the Dominican Republic; Puerta Maya in Cozumel and Grand Turk in Turks & Caicos.

Building on the early success of Celebration Key, which has welcomed more than 3.25 million guests since its opening in July 2025, Carnival revealed plans for two new expansion phases for the destination that will increase total land-side capacity by 6,000 guests, with 3,000 added in each phase.

In 2028, a new portal will introduce even more ways for guests to play and relax together with a heated, beach-entry pool with a swim-up bar; a new social waterslide designed for four to five guests to slide together; and a colorful, aqua play area featuring five waterslides, a dry climbing play structure and drenching bucket created especially for younger children.

In 2030, a new major water park will add 18 waterslides, the cruise industry's longest lazy river with float-up bars and swim-in/swim-out cabanas, as well as a new exclusive area with an infinity pool, more beach access and new dining and bar concepts.

Carnival also announced Serenity Beach, a new complimentary retreat for guests 21 and older coming to RelaxAway, Half Moon Cay in spring 2027. It will feature dedicated loungers and bar and beverage service, with daybeds and cabanas available for an additional charge.

Greater Value from Ship to Shore

Beginning in February 2027, Carnival will extend its drink packages CHEERS!, CHEERS! Zero Proof™, Bottomless Bubbles™ and CHEERS! Social to Celebration Key and RelaxAway, Half Moon Cay, giving guests who purchase these Carnival packages greater value for their vacation dollars.

For additional information on Carnival Cruise Line and to book a cruise vacation on Carnival, call 1-800-CARNIVAL, visit http://carnival.com or contact your favorite travel advisor or online travel site.

ABOUT CARNIVAL CRUISE LINE

Carnival Cruise Line, part of Carnival Corporation (), the world's largest cruise company with a portfolio of cruise lines operating in over 800 ports & destinations worldwide – and is proud to be known as America's Cruise Line and for carrying more Americans and serving more U.S. homeports than any other. Carnival sails more than six and a half million guests annually and in 2023 was the first cruise line to sail more than 100 million guests in total. Operating from 13 U.S. and four Australian homeports, as well as seasonally from Europe, Carnival hosts more than 95,000 guests on its ships every day of the year and employs more than 50,000 team members, representing 120 nationalities.

Since its founding in 1972, Carnival has continually revolutionized the cruise industry and popularized the cruise vacation as an affordable and fun travel option. Carnival's fleet of 29 ships reflects an exciting period of growth that continues with the addition of seven ships through 2035: a fourth and fifth Excel class ship scheduled for 2027 and 2028, respectively; three Ace class ships scheduled for delivery in 2029, 2031 and 2033, beginning with Carnival Destiny; and two additional ships in the new class expected to be delivered in 2033 and 2035. Carnival's newest guest offering is its all-new exclusive destination, Celebration Key on Grand Bahama, which debuted in 2025 to join the company's Paradise Collection of Caribbean gems.

data.title: Anthropic listing extends Nasdaq's dominant run against arch-rival NYSE
data.description:
Key points:
  • Nasdaq IPOs raise about $201.8 billion this year versus $20.8 billion on NYSE, Dealogic data shows
  • Nasdaq finished ahead of NYSE six times in 2018 to 2025 period, according to Dealogic
  • New rules fast-track names like SpaceX into Nasdaq 100 index

By Anirban Sen

The market share battle between the two top US exchanges has never been so lopsided.

With Anthropic's record-breaking initial public offering on Wednesday, Nasdaq snatched another marquee listing from the New York Stock Exchange this year, adding to its already wide lead in the battle for market share against its downtown rival. The exchange displayed the Anthropic win on the huge screens that envelop its Times Square address on Thursday, as more than 800 million shares changed hands in the AI company's debut.

"Anthropic’s IPO is a very proud moment for us," said Adena Friedman, chief executive officer of Nasdaq, in an interview Thursday. "We’ve been engaging with the Anthropic team for a very long time. Separate from the entire listing experience, we've been a client to them, as we are to the AI ecosystem, and so we also have gotten to know them in that context as well."

Over the last decade, the listing advantage has swung decisively in Nasdaq's favor. According to data from Dealogic, there have been 64 IPOs — led by Anthropic and SpaceX — on Nasdaq so far this year, raising about $201.8 billion, dwarfing the $20.8 billion haul raised from 42 IPOs on NYSE.

That is the widest gap in terms of capital raised between the two exchanges record since Dealogic started tracking the data in 1995. In 2017, NYSE raked in share sale proceeds of $28.8 billion from 69 deals, versus Nasdaq's $9.3 billion haul from 86 flotations. However, Nasdaq finished ahead of NYSE six out of eight times between 2018 and 2025, according to Dealogic, and is on track to do so again this year.

Nasdaq’s run of dominance can be linked to several moves the exchange operator has made over the years. Friedman, who has led Nasdaq for a decade, on Thursday cited the exchange operator's strength in marketing IPOs, its investor relations business that helps connect companies with large asset managers and institutional investors, and its index business — which it launched in 1985 — as key competitive advantages.

These efforts have allowed it to build relationships with founders in big IPO hubs like Silicon Valley and contributed to its dominance in tech listings.

"It's a very hard problem (for NYSE) to solve because Nasdaq didn't build its private markets business or its index just two years ago. They have had a head start of several years compared to their competitors. NYSE will have to probably just copy what Nasdaq has done for the past 10 years," said Owen Lau, an analyst at Clear Street.

NYSE executives are under increasing pressure to win the next mega-IPO after the recent losses to Nasdaq, according to two people familiar with the matter. The NYSE did not respond to a request for comment.

"Probably the major reason (for their dominance) is that Nasdaq has their own indexes," said Lau, referring to the Nasdaq 100 and the Nasdaq Composite , which are licensed for use by institutional asset managers. "That is a very big draw for many companies such as SpaceX and Anthropic."

The Nasdaq 100's constituents include several of the world's most valuable companies, such as Apple , Nvidia and Alphabet .

STRATEGIC ADVANTAGE

Admission to benchmarks like the Nasdaq 100 or S&P 500 gives companies increased access to deep-pocketed institutions with large index funds. This broadens the companies' shareholder base and improves share liquidity. The NYSE has a similar index that tracks its 100 largest US stocks that it launched last year, but it is less widely followed by investors.

Nasdaq introduced new rules earlier this year to speed the addition of newly listed megacap companies to the index, a move experts say gives them another advantage over the NYSE, even as it has drawn criticism from some quarters.

In an interview with Bloomberg in May, NYSE President Lynn Martin called the rule changes "questionable." On Thursday, Friedman said only a handful of megacap companies of the size and scale of Anthropic and SpaceX have the potential to be fast-tracked into the Nasdaq 100, adding that market liquidity is not an issue.

Reuters reported in March that SpaceX made early inclusion in the Nasdaq 100 a necessary condition to list on the Nasdaq. The exchange ultimately added the company to the index 15 days after its stock market debut.

data.title: Anthropic's $1.5 trillion debut rewrites venture capital's playbook
data.description:
Key points:
  • Spark led Anthropic's $450 million Series C in 2023 at a $4.5 billion valuation
  • Menlo invested over $1 billion for a stake of nearly 1.5%, a person familiar says
  • Amazon and Google together hold about 28.4% of Anthropic

By Krystal Hu

For decades, venture capital thrived on small bets that became billion-dollar companies.

Then came Anthropic , rewriting the playbook and forcing investors to write fatter checks to buy stakes at unheard-of valuations.

The AI lab’s shares began trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday at a $1.5 trillion valuation, delivering multibillion-dollar windfalls to venture investors at a moment when the industry needs fresh liquidity to fund more bets on AI companies. The stock closed at $97.17, up 17% from its IPO price of $83.

Anthropic's stock market value ended the day at about $1.3 trillion, based on its outstanding shares, or $1.8 trillion, based on its fully diluted shares.

To join the fundraising frenzy, especially at later stages, venture capital firms invested billions, tapping their own investors for additional capital through special-purpose vehicles.

MENLO, SPARK REAP BIG RETURNS

Menlo Ventures and Spark Capital emerged with some of the biggest returns by multiple. Spark Capital was the first venture capital firm to lead an Anthropic investment, in a $450 million Series C round in 2023 at a valuation of $4.5 billion. Spark general partner Yasmin Razavi, who spearheaded the investment, remains the only investor who sits on Anthropic’s board.

Writing the largest check in the firm’s history, early-stage firm Menlo invested over $1 billion for a stake of nearly 1.5%, according to a person familiar with the investment. At a $1.5 trillion market cap, Menlo’s stake is worth over $20 billion.

To invest beyond the capacity of its existing fund, Menlo raised a $750 million special-purpose vehicle from limited partners, a tactic that became increasingly common as funding rounds grew, given the capital needs of AI companies.

THE LATE-STAGE BETS PAID OFF

Sequoia Capital, long known for its early bets, joined a later round and still stands to earn billions of dollars.

Sequoia passed on Anthropic at lower prices. After a leadership change, it wrote its first check at the start of this year, joining a round led by Singapore’s GIC and Coatue at a $380 billion post-money valuation in February. It later co-led, alongside Altimeter, Dragoneer and Greenoaks, a round at $965 billion. Sequoia has invested $3 billion in Anthropic and continued to invest more through Anthropic's IPO, signaling further conviction in the AI lab.

Lightspeed Venture Partners, which invested more than $3 billion in Anthropic, now holds over 2% of the company, making it the largest financial investor in the company, according to two people familiar with the matter.

The returns are possible because of the rapid rise in Anthropic’s valuation and revenue. Its annualized revenue grew from about $1 billion at the start of 2025 to about $81 billion last month, as its valuation climbed from $61.5 billion in March 2025 to $965 billion in the latest private round this May.

Strategic backers, too, supply much of the unprecedented capital and computing power needed by AI labs. The combined stake of Amazon and Alphabet's Google in Anthropic is about 28.4%.

“We're living through a very unique time of profound change happening at a higher velocity than ever before. The scale of the impact of these businesses and the breadth of market opportunities is larger than anything we've seen before. And that is going to afford investment opportunities that are larger than what we've seen in the past,” said Will Griffith, a partner at Iconiq, which has invested $6.1 billion, making the fund the second-largest financial investor by ownership in Anthropic.
